content: Always consult your healthcare professional to obtain comprehensive information about this product and to address your specific health needs. Store this product at room temperature, ensuring it is kept away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Avoid flushing medications down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. When the product is expired or no longer needed, dispose of it properly.
